text: The dataset that detected the 2021 tree-cover loss in the asset, referred to as ASSET-A, was the "Global Forest Change" dataset, version GFC-2025-v1.13, provided by the University of Maryland (Hansen/UMD). This dataset observed an 81.3-hectare tree-cover loss within the asset in 2021. The loss was corroborated by the European Commission Joint Research Centre's "Global Forest Cover 2020" dataset, which agreed on 98% of the event area.
